    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)

    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)

{"thought": "先確認訂單狀態代碼、時間格式與 unit_price_cents 的實際單位（和商品定價比對），再計算銀級會員 2025 上半年淨營收。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status", "SELECT o.order_ts, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, p.list_price_twd FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id LIMIT 10", "SELECT r.order_id, r.item_id, r.refund_amount_twd, r.refund_ts FROM refunds r LIMIT 5"]}}

{"thought": "依語意層定義，淨營收取有效訂單（status 1、2、3）的商品金額（數量 × 單價，單價為分需除以 100）扣除對應退款，期間以台北時間計。銀級會員對應 tier='S'，據此計算 2025 年上半年的數字。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-07-01') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vo) AS valid_orders, (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vo)) AS gross_cents, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vo)) AS refund_twd", "WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-07-01') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vo)) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd), 0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vo)) AS net_revenue_twd"]}}
